title: Attestation (v0)
description: A verifiable, signed claim about an Agent/Principal — identity, license, or a rating. Ratings are anti-manipulation by construction (docs/spec/02 Layer D): a rating attestation MUST reference a settled commitment, so no transaction means no rating.

claim.description: The claim payload. For claim_type='rating', MUST include settled_commitment_ref (structural anti-manipulation, §P4).

settled_commitment_ref.description: Required when claim_type is 'rating'. A rating cannot exist without a settled transaction.

issuer.description: Who verified/produced this. Must be a recognized issuer under the governance trust framework (docs/spec/02 Layer C) for it to carry weight.

expiry.description: Attestations lapse and need re-verification (relevant where periodic re-check is required).
